messages:
marketplace_pm: Quick sync — we need to finalize the regional data residency checklist and cert plan for the Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant connector bundle before GA. Targeting May 8th window. Can team owners confirm blockers?

eng-ryan: Putting up the engineering list: encryption-at-rest verification, network egress rules for EU regions, and schema drift tests. I can own the test harness.

sasha: +1 on schema drift tests. Also need a clear migration path for existing customers using our legacy sidecar. Will we support delta-merge semantics initially?

oliver: From infra side, EU infra has a quota issue for the larger VM spec we need for vector indexing. Talking to cloud infra to bump it — ETA EOD.

maria-ps: Marketing note: we need embargo dates from partners and a draft announcement blurb by next Wed. Snowflake legal asked for a 72h review window.

snow-partner-liaison: Snowflake partner PM confirmed the 72h review and asked for SOC2 evidence for the connector bundle. They want the certification artifacts by Apr 30.

eng-ryan: For SOC2 we can provide the standard security pack but need the change log that shows no customer-data exfiltration paths. @maria-ps can you consolidate docs?

maria-ps: Yep — will pull together the security pack + release blurb. Need the final feature matrix (which models/quantization and by-region support) from eng.

dev-rel-joe: I'm drafting the integration guide. Couple of questions: recommended DBX runtime, connector memory footprints, and the supported vector store config for Qdrant (replication & persistence). Can someone paste the current numbers?

eng-ryan: Current runtime: DBX runtime 13.2, recommended GPU spec: a40x2 or gpus with 48GB. Memory footprint: ~18GB baseline per connector instance under typical load. Qdrant config: replication=2, persist_every=60s (we've flip-flopped on persist_every; happy to adjust).

oliver: Note: for EU we might not get A40 fleet; fallback is A10G which impacts throughput ~25%. Need to call that out in docs and pricing.

marketplace_pm: Action items I heard: 1) eng-ryan owns schema drift tests + runtime numbers (done), 2) oliver to confirm EU quota/VM spec (ETA EOD), 3) maria-ps to assemble security pack + draft blurb (due Apr 28), 4) dev-rel-joe will finalize integration guide once numbers confirmed. Add: partner-bot please create a shared checklist. :clipboard:

partner-bot: Created checklist: https://redwood-internal/partnerships/checklists/1719032468-regional-data-shipping. Tasks assigned to owners.

maria-ps: Can we add a short compatibility table in the announcement that lists: Snowflake (works w/ SnowBridge v2), Databricks (runtime 13.2+), Qdrant (v1.1+, replication=2)? I can format that.

snow-partner-liaison: Snowflake legal also requested a brief runbook for rollback steps in case of PII-mapping regressions. Please include sequence for toggle + emergency cutoff.

eng-ryan: Draft rollback runbook (dev-rel-joe please review):

```
1) Disable ingestion streams in SnowBridge
2) Flip connector to read-only mode via feature-flag
3) Revert migration script to previous schema version (tag: v2026-03-15)
4) Re-enable streams after verification
```

dev-rel-joe: I reviewed runbook — added validation step post-revert to scan for PII tags. Will include sample queries for Snowflake.

marketplace_pm: Good. Last question: do we want a simultaneous marketplace listing with partner co-announcement or staggered? Pros/cons?

maria-ps: Prefer simultaneous for GTM signal, but legal review timelines might force a staggered push. If staggered, have GA docs live before marketplace listing to reduce support load.

oliver: Technically simultaneous is fine if we gate marketplace publish on partner legal sign-off. We can automate the publish step once Snowflake signs off.

marketplace_pm: OK — plan: aim for simultaneous, but build a gated publish flow. I'll schedule a go/no-go 72h before May 8. Thanks all — will update checklist and send calendar invite for triage on Apr 27. :calendar:
file_notes: Slack thread about pre-GA readiness for Snowflake/Databricks/Qdrant connector bundle; includes actions, a short code block for rollback steps, and a partner-bot link.
